prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Houston, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1345; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported in Houston, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just go by my first name for now, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine. Can you walk me through what happened when the vehicles collided?

A: I was driving north on a two-lane road, going maybe twenty-five miles an hour because of the traffic. The other car came over into my lane and we hit nose to nose. It wasn't a hard impact, but it was enough to push my car back a bit and jolt me forward.

Q: Did your airbags deploy?

A: No, they didn't. My seatbelt was on, and I didn't hit anything with my head.

Q: Were you able to get out of the vehicle on your own?

A: Yes, but I felt stiff right away. My neck was sore and my lower back started tightening up within an hour or so.

Q: Have you sought medical attention since the collision?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. They checked my range of motion, gave me a neck brace for a couple of days, and told me I had a neck and back strain. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week since then.

Q: Did you have any neck or back problems before this collision?

A: Nothing serious. I had some occasional stiffness after long days at my desk, but nothing that needed treatment or kept me from working.

Q: Are you currently missing work or limited in your daily activities?

A: I've been working, but I've had to take a few breaks and I can't lift heavy things like groceries without pain. Sleeping is harder too.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Just that I'm trying to follow the treatment plan, and I'm hopeful I'll keep improving.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
